Featured campaign

Store. Protect. Prove.

Most growing SMBs have backups. Fewer can prove recovery. Store-Protect-Prove helps South African FinTech, HealthTech, and trust-sensitive teams validate AWS backup, restore, monitoring, runbooks, and recovery evidence before customers, auditors, or outages ask.

  • Validate what is protected and what can recover.
  • Create restore evidence before scrutiny arrives.
  • Turn backup, monitoring, and runbooks into an operating rhythm.
  • Connect urgent recovery proof to ongoing AWS Managed Platform operations.
Explore Store-Protect-ProvePlan managed AWS support

Build for growth, trust, and recovery.

When you are winning enterprise clients and scaling without compromise, the same foundation carries your story: AWS managed platform operations tuned for South African SMB reality, with clear ownership, secure defaults, and escalation that keeps always-on experiences credible when demand spikes. Add resilience validation, AI automation, Zero Trust, or AWS-aligned data protection where the opportunity warrants, building trust through security and keeping your teams aligned around one coherent operating narrative.

  • As expectations increase, teams are asked to demonstrate reliability, not just intent
  • Recovery and resilience need to be proven, not assumed
  • Growth introduces complexity across ownership, systems, and accountability
  • Enterprise onboarding requires confidence in controls and consistency
  • Teams need one clear operating model they can stand behind
Explore solution paths

How we work with you

We align on an AWS managed platform core, attach programme work when audits or incidents raise the bar, and make outcomes reviewable. Three beats on one operating model, separate from the end to end delivery sequence on our process page.

See the full delivery sequence

Step 1

Platform core first

From Discovery to Scale: Scope constraints, systems, and obligations. You get a plain-language view of resilience and evidence priorities your SMB can act on with confidence.

Step 2

Solutions

Well-Architected Review, migration, recovery, Zero Trust, and automation paths that attach to the same operating model. Add audit, migration, recovery, access, or automation paths when regulators or incidents raise the bar.

Step 3

What you get

Exercises and artefacts that show what actually works, not assumed RTOs. Move from fragmented tools to a clear operating model built for growth, trust, and consistency.

AWS Managed Platform

Ongoing AWS operations for regulated SMB teams that need clear ownership, monitoring, release awareness, recovery routines, access discipline, cost visibility, and evidence-ready reporting. Four engagement stages SMB teams use to align scope, foundation, operations, and scale. Not seat-based software tiers, how we progress work together.

Explore AWS Managed Platform

Discovery

Scope constraints, systems, and obligations. You get a plain-language view of resilience and evidence priorities your SMB can act on with confidence.

Foundation

Establish AWS managed platform posture, secure defaults, and ownership lines your technical leads can defend in reviews.

Operate

Run recurring rhythms: backup health, recovery rehearsal, and incident evidence, so confidence comes from practice, not slides.

Scale

Grow capacity and governance together: onboarding, audit cycles, and multi-team alignment without losing the narrative.

Choose what you need to prove

Each path stands alone or attaches to AWS Managed Platform. Start with what you need to prove, then follow the route that matches audit, migration, recovery, access, or automation needs.

Jonathan Nel

Technical Operations Manager, MRI Software

MRI has had the pleasure of working with KineticSkunk™ and their outstanding DevOps supporting services. As a company who values efficiency, reliability, and continuous improvement in the software development process, we can confidently say that this team exceeded all expectations. Their team demonstrated a deep understanding of DevOps principles and practices. They seamlessly integrated themselves into our existing development processes, working closely with our teams to identify pain points and bottlenecks. Their commitment to collaboration was truly remarkable.

VP Software Engineering, Entersekt

Their dedicated team of DevOps engineers brought a wealth of experience and expertise to the table. Their in-depth knowledge of GitLab and DevOps best practices allowed their staff to swiftly adapt to the new environment and methodologies, ensuring a seamless and efficient transition.
